reasons.min_ram_mb:
RAM bumped 512 -> 1024 (2026-07-28, live-found): the guest ran at 108% of its
512 MB cap continuously for its ENTIRE lifetime while merely idling at a login
prompt (node-manager's own monitor logged "[OOM] VM node vy1 at 108% of RAM cap
(553/512 MB)" every ~10s, non-stop). Confirmed live that 1024 MB eliminates the
OOM pressure entirely (zero such warnings across the same idle window). VyOS
1.5-rolling's own documented minimum is 1 GB - 512 MB was undersized from the
start, not a regression.
reasons.nic:
nic virtio-net-pci vs EVE-NG vyos.yml e1000 (rule #59 drift, reviewed 2026-09-20 Wave 17): VyOS 1.5 rolling
boots + passes traffic on virtio (VERIFIED 2026-06-01, live sweep 2026-09-20 import+boot), virtio is the
netplex default paravirtual NIC for KVM Linux guests; this image does not need e1000.
reasons.day0_channel:
Day-0 (NPX-4988): written onto the node's own overlay BEFORE power-on (VyosConfigPartitionChannel,
day0_disk_channels.py): this bundled 1.5-rolling image has no cloud-init and no CD reader (measured 2026-07-28:
/etc/cloud missing, vyos-config-cloud-init.service never runs), and console typing is banned by the project owner's
no-console-automation rule. VyOS's own boot loads <rw>/opt/vyatta/etc/config/config.boot and runs
config/scripts/vyos-postconfig-bootup.script, so that is where the pasted config is put.
